A strategy for controlling wildfires is to clear an area of forest to create a fire break.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
A new power station for converting wood and plant material into electricity opened in 2020
in Spain.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text:
The power station will produce 325 500 MWh per year of electricity and use 238 000 tonnes
of wood and plant material.
State the electricity produced per day at the power station.
Give your answer to the nearest whole MWh.
______ MWh

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text:
Questionnaires and face-to-face interviews were used to find out local people’s views on
the power station.
Suggest the advantages of using a face-to-face interview compared with a questionnaire
to find out people’s views.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Suggest reasons why people are in favour of having the power station located in their
local area.

parts.label: (iv)
parts.text:
Suggest two factors, other than people’s views, that must be considered before a power
station can be built.

parts.label: (viii)
parts.text:
The farmer exports the grapes to many countries around the world.
The grapes are packaged into boxes at the farm before being transported for export.
Suggest one benefit of packaging the grapes at the farm.

parts.label: (ix)
parts.text:
Grape plants can be genetically modified to make them resistant to cold temperatures.
Suggest why some people are not in favour of genetically modified plants.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text:
Some grape plants can become infected by a disease caused by fungi.
Two methods are used to control the disease:
method 1: Remove and destroy the infected grapes, leaves and stems of the plant.
method 2: Spray the plant with a fungicide.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Suggest why farmers often choose method 2 and spray with a fungicide.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest why climate change can increase the risk of plant diseases caused by fungi.

parts.label: (iii)
parts.text:
Young grape plants are easily damaged by strong winds.
Suggest how young grape plants can be protected from strong winds.
